title: Catch the search race with breakpoints
purpose: Use fetch, line and conditional breakpoints, stepping and async frames to find which response makes the list stale.
sequence_reason: Each pause depends on the one before it, and the call stack changes at every step, so a guided sequence shows the change.
summary: A fetch breakpoint pauses on line 12 each time a request to search?q= starts. A line-of-code breakpoint on line 5 pauses for both responses. A conditional breakpoint with query !== input.value pauses only on the stale re response. Step into enters render, step over runs one line, step out returns. After an await the stack holds only the resumed code; async frames link it back to the code that started the fetch.
explanation: A conditional breakpoint skips the pauses you do not need. Async frames in the Call Stack show which earlier call started the code that is paused now.

learning_check.question: Which breakpoint pauses only on the stale response?
learning_check.answer: A conditional breakpoint on line 5 with the condition query !== input.value.

scenes.heading: The code under test
scenes.narration: The onInput function reads the box on line 3, awaits getJSON on line 4, and calls render on line 5.

visual.subtitle: onInput: line 3 query, line 4 getJSON, line 5 render

scenes.heading: A fetch breakpoint
scenes.narration: An XHR or fetch breakpoint with the text search?q= pauses on line 12 when a request URL contains it. It pauses twice: for re, then for react.

scenes.heading: A line-of-code breakpoint
scenes.narration: A line-of-code breakpoint on line 5 pauses for every response. First react arrives, and query matches the box. Then re arrives, but the box still says react.

items: Pause 1: query is react, box is react
Resume: label says Results for react
Pause 2: query is re, box is react
Resume: label says Results for re

scenes.heading: A conditional breakpoint
scenes.narration: A conditional breakpoint pauses only when its condition is true. With query !== input.value, it skips the fresh react response and stops on the stale re response.

terms.note: the text this call read on line 3
the text in the box now
true only for a stale response

scenes.heading: Step into, over and out
scenes.narration: Step into enters render, so render goes on top of the Call Stack. Step over runs one line. Step out finishes render and returns to onInput.

items: Step into: pause on line 8 in render
Step over: line 8 runs, pause on line 9
Step over: label says Results for re

scenes.heading: Async frames link the call history
scenes.narration: After an await, the stack holds only the resumed code. Async frames link it back to the code that started the fetch, so the Call Stack shows the whole history.

visual.verdict: The async frames show which input event started the stale request.
